name: models/__init__.py
summary: Package-level initialization file that aggregates and exposes QueryFeedback, QueryHistory, and QueryResult for unified imports
purpose: Provides a single entry point for all query-related models so consumers can import directly from the models package without depending on the internal module file structure
responsibilities: Aggregate and expose model classes at the package level
Provide a clean public API for importing query domain models
Abstract internal file organization from external consumers
outputs: Unified package namespace containing QueryFeedback, QueryHistory, and QueryResult
architecture_notes: Implements the Aggregate Module / Facade pattern to decouple consumers from internal file layout. Follows Django and Python convention where __init__.py acts as the public interface of the models package, allowing internal refactoring without breaking external imports.
improvements: Add an explicit __all__ list to prevent namespace pollution and clarify the public API
Consider lazy imports if circular dependencies arise during model loading
Add type hints and module-level docstring for better IDE discoverability and static analysis
